evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
[patreon] fix not being able to download embedded videos

**IMPORTANT**: PRs without the template will be CLOSED

### Description of your *pull request* and other information

It seems the `post_file['name']` attribute no longer exists in the Patreon video attributes (at least in the posts I tested, but unsure if it may exist in some cases), so the check for the case of m3u8 downloads was being skipped, so I changed it to also check for `post_file['duration']` and assume it is a video in this case. Is this a good enough check for this case?
